tcs.tc_title: Controls and Settings tabs present in Vehicle Category
tcs.test_item:
The Vehicle Category will contain the Controls and Settings tabs.

(Tab set composition -- which tabs exist, not which one is active)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Vehicle Category feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the tabs shown along the Vehicle Category tab bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The tab bar contains a "Controls" tab and a "Settings" tab
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Vehicle Category 之主要頁籤集含 Controls 與 Settings。**關鍵情境條件**：車輛配備該 feature。**為什麼這樣切**：本 leaf 只擁有「有哪些頁籤」一句；哪一個為預設作用中屬 -001-02、回復上次屬 -001-03（§8.2.2）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 頁籤集之組成（對 -001-02 之首次預設、-001-03 之回復）

tcs.tc_title: Controls active on first entry
tcs.test_item:
On first entry to the Vehicle Category, display the Controls tab.

(Default active tab on the first entry, before any tab history exists)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the Vehicle Category feature
2. The user has not previously entered the Vehicle Category
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen
2. Record which tab is active on entry
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed
2. The "Controls" tab is the active tab
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：首次進入時預設作用頁籤為 Controls。**關鍵情境條件**：尚無頁籤瀏覽紀錄 —— 此為與 -001-03 之分界。**為什麼這樣切**：037 已將「首次」與「其後」拆為二 leaf，依 R-VC18 之一 leaf 一 TC 先例不合併。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 進入次序：首次（對 -001-03 之後續進入）

tcs.tc_title: Last viewed tab restored on re-entry
tcs.test_item:
After that, return to the Last Viewed tab.

(Tab restored on a subsequent entry, after a tab other than the default was viewed)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Vehicle Category feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Settings" tab
2. Leave the Vehicle Category screen
3. Open the Vehicle Category screen again and record which tab is active
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "Settings" tab is displayed as the active tab
2. The Vehicle Category screen is closed
3. The "Settings" tab is the active tab on re-entry
tcs.design_method: 狀態轉換 (State Transition Testing)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：再次進入時回復上次瀏覽之頁籤，而非回到預設之 Controls。**關鍵情境條件**：離開前之作用頁籤非預設值 —— 若取 Controls 則本 TC 與-001-02 無法區辨。**為什麼這樣切**：本 leaf 之標的為回復行為，首次之預設屬 -001-02。**設計方法**：離開 → 再進入之狀態轉換。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 進入次序：後續進入之回復（對 -001-02 之首次預設）

tcs.tc_title: Specialty tabs placed left of Controls and Settings
tcs.test_item:
VC2.) If the vehicle is equipped with Specialty features, they will appear as tabs to the left of Controls and Settings.

(Specialty tab placement relative to the two base tabs)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with at least one Specialty feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the left-to-right order of the tabs along the tab bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Specialty feature tabs are positioned to the left of the "Controls" and "Settings" tabs
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Specialty 頁籤出現且位於 Controls／Settings 之左。**關鍵情境條件**：車輛配備至少一個 Specialty feature —— 未配備則無標的。**為什麼這樣切**：本 leaf 之標的為**相對位置**；固定優先序屬 -003，可列入之功能列舉屬 -006。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 排列面向：相對於基本頁籤之位置（對 -003 之固定優先序）

tcs.tc_title: Tab priority order follows the fixed five-position list
tcs.test_item:
VC2.0.1.) The priority order for the tabs will be: 1) My Car, 2) Cameras, 3) Other equipped Specialty Features, 4) Controls, 5) Settings.

(Absolute ordering across all five tab positions, not a relative placement)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with My Car, Cameras and at least one other Specialty feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record the left-to-right order of every tab along the tab bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The tabs are ordered as My Car, Cameras, other equipped Specialty features, "Controls", "Settings"
tcs.design_method: 決策表 (Decision Table Testing)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：五個位置之固定優先序。**關鍵情境條件**：須同時配備 My Car、Cameras 與其他 Specialty，否則序列不完整而無法驗其優先。**為什麼這樣切**：-002 驗相對位置（Specialty 在左），本 leaf 驗**絕對序**；二者為不同標的。**設計方法**：多個配備條件共同決定一個排列，取決策表。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 排列面向：五位置之絕對優先序（對 -002 之相對位置）

tcs.distinguishing_axis: 標籤標的：Controls 頁籤（對 -005 之 Settings 頁籤）

tcs.tc_title: Off Road, PHEV and SRT eligible as Specialty tabs
tcs.test_item:
VC2.1.) The specialty features include, but are not limited to: Off Road, PHEV, SRT.

(Membership of the Specialty set, which the source states is open-ended)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Off Road, PHEV and SRT features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record which Specialty feature tabs are present on the tab bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. Off Road, PHEV and SRT are each present as a Specialty feature tab
tcs.design_method: 等價劃分 (Equivalence Partitioning, EP)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：來源所列舉之三個 Specialty 功能確可成為頁籤。**關鍵情境條件**：三者皆配備。**為什麼這樣切**：來源明文 `include, but are not limited to` —— **該列舉非窮舉**，故本 TC 只驗所列之三者為**有效成員**，不驗「僅此三者」（那會是對開放列舉之錯誤封閉，觸 §8.4.2）。**未涵蓋**：列舉外之 Specialty 功能 —— 來源未給其名，不造值（§8.4.1）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 集合面向：列舉成員之有效性（非窮舉，故不驗排他）

tcs.tc_title: Cameras tab surfaced when Camera App is equipped
tcs.test_item:
VC3.) If the vehicle has the Camera App (see Camera HMI Logic and Flow), Cameras will appear as a tab.

(Presence of the Cameras tab, delegating the Camera App behaviour itself)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Camera App
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record whether a Cameras tab is present on the tab bar
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. A Cameras tab is present on the Vehicle Category tab bar
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：配備 Camera App 時 Cameras 出現為頁籤。**關鍵情境條件**：車輛配備 Camera App。**未涵蓋 —— §8.4.2 之委派**：來源明文 `(see Camera HMI Logic and Flow)`，**Camera App 自身之任何行為皆不在本 TC 範圍**（開啟後之畫面、影像、切換等），其屬 Camera HMI Logic and Flow 之 SWE 需求。本 TC 僅驗頁籤之出現。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: Camera 面向：頁籤之出現（對 -009 之 Controls 內去重）

tcs.tc_title: Cameras entry removed from Controls when the tab is present
tcs.test_item:
VC3.1.) If the Camera tab is present, remove Cameras from the Controls tab.

(Suppression inside the Controls list, the second consequence of the same trigger)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with the Camera App
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Record whether a Cameras entry is present in the "Controls" list
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The "Controls" list does not contain a Cameras entry while the Cameras tab is present
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Cameras 頁籤存在時，Controls 內之 Cameras 項被移除。**關鍵情境條件**：同 -008 之觸發（配備 Camera App）。**為什麼這樣切**：本筆與 -008 為**同一觸發之兩個後果**，037 已拆為二 leaf —— 依 R-VC18 之一 leaf 一 TC 先例**不合併**（§8.2.2 之反向；下放包 14 §2.5 已裁）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: Camera 面向：Controls 內去重（對 -008 之頁籤出現）

tcs.tc_title: Dashboard shows only equipped apps
tcs.test_item:
VC4.) Only show apps under the Dashboard tab that the vehicle is equipped with.

(Filtering by vehicle equipment, not the ordering of what survives)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with a subset of the Dashboard apps
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record which apps are listed under the Dashboard tab
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. Only the apps the vehicle is equipped with are listed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Dashboard 只顯示車輛實際配備之 app。**關鍵情境條件**：車輛配備部分而非全部 Dashboard apps —— 全配備則過濾與否無從區辨。**為什麼這樣切**：本 leaf 之標的為**過濾**，排序屬 -011。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: Dashboard 面向：依配備過濾（對 -011 之排序）

tcs.tc_title: Dashboard content follows the table order
tcs.test_item:
VC4.1) Within the Dashboard tab, display the applicable content in order of the table.

(Ordering of the surviving content, table identity pending)
tcs.pre_conditions: 1. The vehicle is equipped with two or more Dashboard apps
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record the order of the content listed under the Dashboard tab and compare it against PENDING: DR-VC9 Dashboard content table
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The content is listed in the order defined by the referenced table
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：Dashboard 內容依表排序。**⚠ PENDING（IN §8.4.3）**：來源逐字為 `in order of the table`，**`the table` 未具名**。自上下文查：章 2 之唯一表為 §2.4 之 Vehicle Tab Labels and Order，但該表談的是 Vehicle Category 之頁籤，本節談的是 Dashboard 內之 apps —— **層級不同**；`HMI Settings List`（已在手）亦查無 Dashboard 內容之排序表。**不自行認定**（§8.4.1），以 `PENDING: DR-VC9 Dashboard content table` 佔位。**排序規則本身為需求無疑**，故本筆生成而非保留（R-VC22 之 a 段）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: Dashboard 面向：排序（對 -010 之過濾）

tcs.tc_title: Single feature fills one full-width banner
tcs.test_item:
For landscape displays: If there is only one feature, display it in the single banner.

(Landscape, exactly one feature -- the lower bound of the banner rules)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a landscape display
2. The vehicle is equipped with exactly one Dashboard feature
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record how the single feature is rendered
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The feature is rendered as a single full-width banner
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：橫向版面下，恰一個 feature 時之呈現。**關鍵情境條件**：恰一個 —— 取二個則落入 -012-02 之規則。**設計方法**：一／二／二以上為同一規則族之三段，本筆為其下界。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：恰一個（對 -012-02 之二個以上）

tcs.tc_title: Two features render as paired half banners
tcs.test_item:
If there are two or more features, display them in the two half banners (topmost feature in the left, followed by the right), continuing with additional features below the banners (refer to PDO Graphics).

(Landscape, exactly two features -- the lower bound of the two-or-more rule)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a landscape display
2. The vehicle is equipped with exactly two Dashboard features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record how the two features are rendered and their left-to-right order
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The two features are rendered as paired half banners, with the topmost feature on the left and the next on the right
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：橫向版面下，二個 feature 之配對半幅呈現與其左右次序。**⚠ 取「恰好兩個」為測試資料之依據（下放包 15 §3.2）**：**SYS1 §2.6.2 有三句，037 之 leaf 覆蓋第 1、3 句；第 2 句無對應 leaf。**第 2 句逐字為 `If there are two features, display them in the two half banners (topmost feature in the left, followed by the right).`，其在語意上被第 3 句之 `two or more` 涵蓋 —— 即**第 2 句為第 3 句之下界**，而規格對該下界有明文。依 §8.3，本 TC 以「恰好兩個」為測試資料；取三個以上則下界未被觸及。**test_item 上半取 SYS1 之完整句**（第 3 句），因 037 之 `012-02` 為該句之前半、`012-03` 為其續行（下放包 14 §2.2）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：恰兩個（下界；對 -012-03 之額外 feature）

tcs.tc_title: Additional features placed below the banner row
tcs.test_item:
If there are two or more features, display them in the two half banners (topmost feature in the left, followed by the right), continuing with additional features below the banners (refer to PDO Graphics).

(Landscape, more than two features -- placement of the overflow)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a landscape display
2. The vehicle is equipped with three or more Dashboard features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record where the features beyond the first two are placed and compare their layout against PENDING: DR-VC9 PDO graphics
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The features beyond the first two are placed below the half banner row
tcs.design_method: 等價劃分 (Equivalence Partitioning, EP)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：橫向版面下，超出前二個之 feature 置於半幅列之下方。**test_item 上半取 SYS1 之完整句**：037 之 `012-03` 逐字為 `continuing with additional features below the banners (refer to PDO Graphics)` —— **小寫起首之句中片段**，單獨作為上半讀者無法理解其所指。依 R-S4「上半為需求／規格原句」，取完整句比取片段**更忠實於原句**（下放包 14 §2.2）。**本 leaf 之驗證範圍以括號下半為準**。**⚠ PENDING**：其細部版面 `refer to PDO Graphics` 之標的未到手，以 `PENDING: DR-VC9 PDO graphics` 佔位；**相對位置（在半幅列下方）可觀察**，故本筆生成而非保留（R-VC22 之 a 段）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：三個以上之溢位置放（對 -012-02 之恰兩個）

tcs.tc_title: Up to three features each get a single banner
tcs.test_item:
For portrait displays: for up to three features, display each in a single banner in rows.

(Portrait, up to three features -- one banner per feature)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a portrait display
2. The vehicle is equipped with three Dashboard features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record how the three features are rendered
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. Each of the three features is rendered as its own single banner, stacked in rows
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：直向版面下，至三個 feature 時各佔一列單幅。**關鍵情境條件**：取三個 —— 該規則之上界（`up to three`），取一或二則未觸及上界。**設計方法**：三／四以上為相鄰之二段，本筆為前段之上界。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：至三個（對 -013-02 之四個以上）

tcs.tc_title: Four features split into two singles and one shared row
tcs.test_item:
For four or more features, display the first two features as single banners, the next two features as half banners in the same row, and follow with remaining features as tiles below the half banners.

(Portrait, exactly four features -- the lower bound of the four-or-more rule)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a portrait display
2. The vehicle is equipped with exactly four Dashboard features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record how each of the four features is rendered
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The first two features are rendered as single banners and the next two as half banners sharing one row
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：直向版面下，四個 feature 之前二單幅、後二共列半幅。**關鍵情境條件**：恰四個 —— `four or more` 之下界（§8.3）。**test_item 上半取 SYS1 之完整句**：037 之 `013-02` **在句中補了句號並刪去 `and`**，使其看似完整句；其實與 `013-03` 同屬一句（下放包 14 §2.2）。取完整句以忠實於原句。**本 leaf 之驗證範圍以括號下半為準** —— 剩餘 feature 之磚塊置放屬 -013-03。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：恰四個（下界；對 -013-03 之剩餘 feature）

tcs.tc_title: Remaining features placed as tiles below the shared row
tcs.test_item:
For four or more features, display the first two features as single banners, the next two features as half banners in the same row, and follow with remaining features as tiles below the half banners.

(Portrait, more than four features -- placement of the remainder as tiles)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a portrait display
2. The vehicle is equipped with five or more Dashboard features
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Vehicle Category screen and select the "Controls" tab
2. Select the Dashboard tab
3. Record where the features beyond the first four are placed and in what form
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Vehicle Category screen is displayed with the "Controls" tab active
2. The Dashboard tab is displayed
3. The features beyond the first four are placed as tiles below the half banner row
tcs.design_method: 等價劃分 (Equivalence Partitioning, EP)
tcs.reasoning: **驗證目標**：直向版面下，超出前四個之 feature 以磚塊置於半幅列下方。**test_item 上半取 SYS1 之完整句**：037 之 `013-03` 逐字為 `follow with remaining features as tiles below the half banners` —— **小寫起首之句中片段**。同 -013-02 之處置，取完整句（下放包 14 §2.2）。**本 leaf 之驗證範圍以括號下半為準**。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 數量段：五個以上之剩餘置放（對 -013-02 之恰四個）
